Package com.hkust.marketplace.models

Class ChatThread

java.lang.Object
com.hkust.marketplace.models.ChatThread
public class ChatThread extends Object
The private chat between one buyer and the seller of one listing (ChatThread in the domain class diagram; UC6). The thread holds its messages in order; its offers are the offers with the same buyer and listing, kept in DataStore.
